id: title:danielcarletti:read an evolving json object as the json type

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion and HogQL metadata correctness for ClickHouse JSON columns.
review.reason: Adds a private helper and two unit tests to ensure ClickHouse JSON columns are stored and represented as JSON rather than Tuple, preventing unreadable keys. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion and query metadata.
review.uncertainty: No runtime or integration tests observed; benefit relies on test assertions and implementation changes rather than demonstrated production behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, conservative group. No missing context or unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned; tier assignment requires a score, not an observation-only JSON.

observations.behavior: Adds a parametrized unit test for JSON column storage, asserting that the stored ClickHouse type is JSON rather than a Tuple of sampled keys.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: tests that JSON columns are stored as JSON type, not Tuple, to avoid unreadable keys.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test asserting hogql_definition returns a HogQLDataWarehouseTable with structure '`usage` JSON'.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: tests that JSON columns are represented correctly in the HogQL definition.

observations.behavior: Adds a private method _nested_object_column_type that returns JSON instead of Tuple when the described type is Tuple and format is JSON.
observations.posthog_connection: Warehouse ingestion: prevents storing sampled-key Tuples for JSON columns, which would make keys outside the sample unreadable.
